post.title: What to Do If Your Car Breaks Down on a Busy Highway
post.excerpt: Step-by-step instructions to keep yourself safe while waiting for emergency assistance or a tow truck on high-speed roads.
post.content:
Step-by-step instructions to keep yourself safe while waiting for emergency assistance or a tow truck on high-speed roads.

Understanding the Basics

Whether you're dealing with an emergency or performing routine maintenance, knowledge is your best defense against the unexpected. Taking the time to properly inspect your car can prevent costly breakdowns.

"Preparation is the key to safety on the road. A few minutes of checks can save you hours of stress." - David Mensah

Key Recommendations

In addition to standard guidelines, we strongly recommend that you:

  • Check Regularly: Inspect essential components before every major trip.
  • Use Quality Parts: Never compromise on tires, brakes, or fluids.
  • Consult Professionals: If you're unsure about an unusual noise, have a certified mechanic take a look.
  • Stay Safe: In an emergency, always prioritize your physical safety over the car.

When to Call for Help

Some situations are too dangerous to handle alone. If your car breaks down on a busy highway, loses power steering, or experiences severe overheating, pull over safely and call a professional towing service immediately.

Final Thoughts

By staying proactive about car care and understanding your roadside assistance options, you can travel with peace of mind. Remember, our 24/7 emergency dispatch team is always just a phone call away.
post.author: David Mensah

st_faq.question: What is your average response time for emergency towing?
st_faq.answer: Within the Greater Accra and Ashanti regions, we guarantee a response time of 30-45 minutes. For areas outside major city limits, response times may vary depending on distance and highway traffic conditions.

st_faq.question: What areas do your towing services cover?
st_faq.answer: We offer nationwide coverage across all 16 regions of Ghana through our owned fleet and vetted partner network, with primary rapid-response zones in Accra, Tema, Kumasi, and Takoradi.

st_faq.question: How much does a standard tow cost?
st_faq.answer: Towing costs depend on the distance and the type of vehicle. Our base rate starts at GH₵ 250 within city limits. We provide upfront, transparent pricing before dispatching a truck.

st_faq.question: Do you work with insurance companies?
st_faq.answer: Yes, we are approved by most major insurance providers in Ghana. If you have roadside assistance coverage, we can often bill your insurance directly.

st_faq.question: Can you tow lowered or modified cars?
st_faq.answer: Absolutely. We operate hydraulic flatbed tow trucks equipped with low-angle ramps specifically designed to safely transport modified, sports, or lowered luxury cars without bumper damage.

st_faq.question: What are the eligibility requirements to rent a car?
st_faq.answer: You must be at least 21 years old (25 for luxury or SUV classes), possess a valid Ghanaian driver’s license or an International Driving Permit, and provide a valid ID and security deposit.

st_faq.question: Is a security deposit required for rentals?
st_faq.answer: Yes, a refundable security deposit is required for all rentals. The amount varies based on the vehicle category and is refunded within 3-5 business days after return in good order.

st_faq.question: What is your rental cancellation policy?
st_faq.answer: Cancellations made 48 hours prior to the pickup time are fully refunded. Cancellations within 48 hours may incur a one-day rental charge.

st_faq.question: Can I rent a car with a professional chauffeur?
st_faq.answer: Yes, we offer chauffeur services for an additional daily fee. All our drivers are professionally trained, vetted, uniformed, and familiar with inter-city travel routes.

st_faq.question: Are there mileage limits on rentals?
st_faq.answer: Most standard rentals come with unlimited mileage within Greater Accra. Cross-country journeys or long-term commercial rentals receive generous daily mileage allowances.

st_faq.question: How long does a standard vehicle service take?
st_faq.answer: A routine maintenance service (oil change, filter replacement, fluid top-up, and multipoint inspection) typically takes 1 to 2 hours if you have a scheduled appointment.

st_faq.question: Do you offer a warranty on mechanical repairs?
st_faq.answer: Yes, all our mechanical repairs and labor come with a minimum 6-month or 10,000 km warranty. Parts warranties depend on the manufacturer but typically range from 1 to 2 years.

st_faq.question: Do you use genuine OEM parts for repairs?
st_faq.answer: We offer the choice between genuine OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) parts and high-quality, certified aftermarket alternatives to suit your budget.

st_faq.question: Can I get a loaner car while my car is being repaired?
st_faq.answer: Loaner cars are available subject to availability and the nature of the repair. Priority is given to fleet partners and customers undergoing major engine overhauls.

st_faq.question: Do you provide printed diagnostic reports?
st_faq.answer: Yes, every computerized diagnostic scan comes with a detailed, easy-to-understand printed or digital report outlining fault codes and recommended solutions.

st_faq.question: Do you offer vehicle financing or installment options?
st_faq.answer: Yes, we partner with leading Ghanaian banks and financial institutions to offer flexible auto loan options with competitive interest rates and terms up to 48 months.

st_faq.question: Are your used cars inspected before being listed?
st_faq.answer: Absolutely. Every pre-owned vehicle undergoes a rigorous 150-point mechanical, electrical, and structural inspection before being listed for sale.

st_faq.question: Can I trade in my current vehicle?
st_faq.answer: Yes, we accept trade-ins. Bring your car in for a complimentary appraisal, and the value can be applied directly toward your new purchase.

st_faq.question: Do you import custom vehicles on request?
st_faq.answer: Yes, if we don’t have what you’re looking for in stock, we can source, inspect, and import specific makes and models from North America, Europe, or Asia on your behalf.

st_faq.question: What kind of warranty comes with purchased cars?
st_faq.answer: Brand new vehicles come with full manufacturer warranty. Certified pre-owned cars include our standard 3-month/5,000 km warranty with optional extended coverage.

st_faq.question: How do I know if a spare part is compatible with my car?
st_faq.answer: You can provide us with your vehicle’s Chassis Number (VIN), and our parts specialists will verify 100% exact compatibility before dispatch.

st_faq.question: What is your return policy for auto parts?
st_faq.answer: Unused, uninstalled parts in their original packaging can be returned within 14 days of purchase with a valid receipt.

st_faq.question: Do you deliver auto parts nationwide?
st_faq.answer: Yes, we offer same-day delivery within Accra/Tema for orders placed before 12 PM, and reliable 1-2 day courier delivery nationwide.

st_faq.question: Can I buy a part and have your workshop install it?
st_faq.answer: Certainly. When you purchase parts from our store, our certified garage can install them for you at a discounted workshop labor rate.

st_faq.question: What payment methods do you accept?
st_faq.answer: We accept Mobile Money (MTN MoMo, Telecel Cash, AT Money), major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard), direct bank transfers, and cash at our branch counters.

st_faq.question: Can you provide VAT invoices for corporate accounting?
st_faq.answer: Yes, Santa Towing is a fully incorporated Ghanaian entity and issues official GRA VAT-compliant invoices and electronic receipts.

st_faq.question: What is the minimum number of cars for a corporate fleet account?
st_faq.answer: Our corporate fleet maintenance and towing programs typically cater to 5+ vehicles, with custom packages available for smaller startup fleets.

st_faq.question: Do corporate fleet accounts receive discounted rates?
st_faq.answer: Yes, corporate partners enjoy dedicated account managers, priority 24/7 dispatch, and volume discounts on routine maintenance, tires, and towing services.
